subject: Help us prioritize nimble development ideas

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Help us prioritize nimble development ideas
parts:
Dear nimble-users

As a step towards seeking more funding for nimble development work, we have put together a short Google Forms survey for users.  We'd be grateful if you'd be willing to contribute your input on it.  The survey is here: https://forms.gle/Rh9p5Vth4jtPNs8n7

We are asking people to complete the survey by the end of Friday, October 15.

 It should only take a few minutes.  Thank you!

-Perry

P.S. I've heard that Google Forms may be blocked in some parts of the world.  Apologies if that makes you unable to participate.

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Help us prioritize nimble development ideas
parts:
There's still time to take a few minutes for our survey.  It will help us prioritize future development ideas.  Thanks to everyone who has already done the survey.

-Perry
